breakdown.description: For curved flow, pressure is higher on the outside of the turn to provide the required centripetal force; stating pressure increases toward the center reverses the correct direction of the pressure gradient.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to fix the core physical inaccuracy. The incomplete prompt incorrectly stated that pressure increases toward the center of curvature. The ground truth corrects this by using a formula where pressure increases outward from the center. The agent's generated specification repeated the original error verbatim, stating, 'The pressure increases toward the center of curvature, so the inner side is at higher pressure.'
